notizie.titolo: Ukraine: EU lists 113 individuals and entities to further restrict Russia’s ability to finance its war of aggression
notizie.descrizione: The Council has imposed restrictive measures on 12 individuals and 101 entities active in the banking, financial and energy sectors for their role in financing Russia’s war efforts and supporting its shadow fleet.

notizie.titolo: EU Global Human Rights Sanctions Regime: Council lists four Haitian entities over serious human rights violations
notizie.descrizione: The Council adopted restrictive measures against four Haitian criminal armed groups responsible for grave violations against children in armed conflict, including killings, sexual violence and the recruitment of children.

notizie.titolo: Russia’s FIMI and malicious cyber activities: Council imposes sanctions on 30 individuals and two entities
notizie.descrizione: The Council adopted restrictive measures against 30 individuals and one entity responsible for actions on behalf of the Russian Federation undermining and threatening democracy, stability or security in the EU and some its Member States or in third countries. It also listed one entity responsible for cyber-attacks on Ukrainian, US, and EU government bodies, critical infrastructure, and private companies.

notizie.titolo: Hamas and the Palestinian Islamic Jihad: EU adds one entity and its founder to the sanctions list
notizie.descrizione: The Council has added one individual and one entity to the sanctions list against Hamas and the Palestinian Islamic Jihad, for their role in financing Hamas.

notizie.titolo: Ukraine Facility: Council approves largest-ever payment of €8 billion to Kyiv
notizie.descrizione: The Council approved a record payment of just under €8 billion for Ukraine under the Ukraine Facility, following Ukraine’s successful completion of over 20 target steps under the Ukraine Plan.

notizie.titolo: Press briefing - Education, Youth, Culture and Sport Council of 19 and 20 November 2026
notizie.descrizione: Press briefing ahead of the upcoming Education, Youth, Culture and Sport Council will take place on 16 November 2026 at 11.00

notizie.titolo: European Peace Facility: Council increases support for maritime security in the Gulf of Guinea to €31 million
notizie.descrizione: The Council increased financial support through the European Peace Facility (EPF) from €21 million to €31 million, benefitting military actors and navies of coastal states involved in maritime security operations in the Gulf of Guinea.

notizie.titolo: ISRAELE/PALESTINA: dichiarazione dell'alta rappresentante, a nome dell'Unione europea, sugli sviluppi umanitari a Gaza
notizie.descrizione: L'alta rappresentante ha formulato una dichiarazione a nome dell'Unione europea sugli sviluppi umanitari a Gaza.

notizie.descrizione: Nel corso della conferenza stampa tenutasi al termine della riunione informale dei capi di Stato o di governo del 13 novembre 2026, il presidente António Costa ha presentato i principali risultati delle discussioni sull'intelligenza artificiale e sull'Ucraina.

notizie.titolo: Sistema di scambio di quote di emissione: il Consiglio e il Parlamento convengono di aumentare le quote di carbonio gratuite per le industrie ad alta intensità energetica
notizie.descrizione: Il Consiglio ha raggiunto un accordo provvisorio con il Parlamento europeo sull'aumento delle quote di carbonio gratuite per i settori industriali che rientrano nei parametri di riferimento ETS relativi a calore e combustibili per il periodo 2026-2030.

notizie.titolo: Remarks by President António Costa at the press conference following the meeting of the European Political Community in Dublin
notizie.descrizione: President of the European Council, António Costa, outlined the main results of the discussions of the leaders during the meeting of the European Political Community held in Dublin, Ireland, on 12 November 2026.

notizie.titolo: Pesca e acquacoltura: il Consiglio e il Parlamento concordano un quadro aggiornato per le statistiche
notizie.descrizione: Il Consiglio e il Parlamento europeo concordano un quadro aggiornato per le statistiche sulla pesca e sull'acquacoltura, che migliora la qualità dei dati e ne semplifica la trasmissione in tutta l'UE.

notizie.titolo: Statement after the Leaders Meeting of the Core Group of Support to Armenia
notizie.descrizione: Leaders and representatives of Estonia, France, Latvia, Lithuania, the United Kingdom and the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, met on 12 November 2026 with Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan on the margins of the European Political Community summit in Dublin. Joined by Germany, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Sweden, the President of the European Council and the President of the European Commission, they issued a statement.

notizie.titolo: Joint statement by President Costa and President von der Leyen following their meeting with President Zelenskyy in Dublin
notizie.descrizione: President Costa and President von der Leyen issued a joint statement following their meeting with President of Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Dublin, on 12 November 2026.

notizie.titolo: Opening remarks by President António Costa at the meeting of the European Political Community in Dublin
notizie.descrizione: On 12 November 2026, the President of the European Council, António Costa, co-chaired the ninth meeting of the European Political Community in Dublin, Ireland.
